```{r format and filter, include = FALSE}
format_sfp_data <- function(x) {
  x %>%
  mutate(
    path = tolower(path),
    sizegb = round(sizemb / 1000, 3),
    cost = round(sizemb / 1000, 3) * 2.7,
    lastaccessdate   = convert.date(lastaccessdate),
    modificationdate = convert.date(modificationdate),
    creationdate     = convert.date(creationdate),
    # <<< one-line remap of path values >>>
    path = remap_substrings(path))%>% 
  select(filename, path, sizemb, sizegb, cost, lastaccessdate, modificationdate, creationdate)
}
```

```{r create a filtering function, include=FALSE}
filter_by_prefixes <- function(df, prefixes) {

  if (length(prefixes) == 0) {
    return(df[0, ])
  }

  keep <- Reduce(
    `|`,
    lapply(prefixes, function(p) startsWith(df$path, p))
  )

  df[keep, ]
}
```

```{r create filtered tables, include = FALSE}
prefixes <- get_prefixes()

filtered_tables_old <- lapply(
  prefixes,
  function(x) filter_by_prefixes(format_sfp_data(sfp_old), x)
)

filtered_tables_new <- lapply(
  prefixes,
  function(x) filter_by_prefixes(format_sfp_data(sfp_new), x)
)
```

```{r find duplicate files, include = FALSE}
# find files that are duplicated in both name and size
find_duplicates <- function(x) {
  x %>%
    group_by(filename, sizegb) %>%
    filter(n() > 1) %>%
    ungroup()
}

duplicate_tables_old <- lapply(
  filtered_tables_old,
  find_duplicates
)

duplicate_tables_new <- lapply(
  filtered_tables_new,
  find_duplicates
)

files_duplicated <- function(x, prefixes) {

  prefixes <- prefixes[order(nchar(prefixes), decreasing = TRUE)]

  x %>%
    mutate(
      prefix_path = sapply(
        path,
        function(p) {
          matches <- prefixes[startsWith(tolower(p), tolower(prefixes))]

          if (length(matches) > 0) {
            matches[1]   # longest matching prefix
          } else {
            NA_character_
          }
        }
      )
    ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(prefix_path)) %>%
    group_by(prefix_path) %>%
    summarise(
      duplicates = n(),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
}

prefixes <- get_prefixes()

files_duplicated_old <- Map(
  files_duplicated,
  duplicate_tables_old,
  prefixes
)

files_duplicated_new <- Map(
  files_duplicated,
  duplicate_tables_new,
  prefixes
)
```

```{r join duplicate tables, include=FALSE}
join_dupes <- function(old_df, new_df) {

  full_join(
    old_df,
    new_df,
    by = "prefix_path",
    suffix = c("_old", "_new")
  ) %>%
    rename(
      `folder path` = prefix_path,
      `old dupe count` = duplicates_old,
      `new dupe count` = duplicates_new
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      across(
        c(`old dupe count`, `new dupe count`),
        ~ replace_na(., 0)
      ),
      `dupe count change` =
        as.numeric(`new dupe count`) -
        as.numeric(`old dupe count`)
    )
}

joined_dupes <- Map(
  join_dupes,
  files_duplicated_old,
  files_duplicated_new
)

#head(joined_dupes$hq_victoria)
```


```{r calculate folder totals, include = FALSE}
calc_folder_totals <- function(x, prefixes) {

  prefixes <- prefixes[order(nchar(prefixes), decreasing = TRUE)]

  x %>%
    mutate(
      prefix_path = sapply(
        path,
        function(p) {
          matches <- prefixes[startsWith(
            tolower(p),
            tolower(prefixes)
          )]

          if (length(matches) > 0) {
            matches[1]
          } else {
            NA_character_
          }
        }
      )
    ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(prefix_path)) %>%
    group_by(prefix_path) %>%
    summarise(
      `folder size gb` = sum(sizegb, na.rm = TRUE),
      `number of files` = n(),
      `folder cost` = sum(cost, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
}

prefixes <- get_prefixes()

folder_totals_old <- Map(
  calc_folder_totals,
  filtered_tables_old,
  prefixes
)

folder_totals_new <- Map(
  calc_folder_totals,
  filtered_tables_new,
  prefixes
)

#head(folder_totals_old$hq_victoria)
```

```{r join old and new tables, include = FALSE}
join_totals <- function(old_totals, new_totals, join_dupes) {

  epsilon <- 1e-6

  full_join(
    old_totals,
    new_totals,
    by = "prefix_path",
    suffix = c("_old", "_new")
  ) %>%
    rename(
      `folder path` = prefix_path,
      `old folder size gb` = `folder size gb_old`,
      `new folder size gb` = `folder size gb_new`,
      `old file count` = `number of files_old`,
      `new file count` = `number of files_new`,
      `old folder cost` = `folder cost_old`,
      `new folder cost` = `folder cost_new`
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      across(
        c(
          `old folder size gb`,
          `new folder size gb`,
          `old file count`,
          `new file count`,
          `old folder cost`,
          `new folder cost`
        ),
        ~ replace_na(., 0)
      )
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      "Accountable Excluded Manager Position" = NA,
      "Accountable Excluded Manager Incumbent" = NA,
      `folder size change gb` =
        `new folder size gb` - `old folder size gb`,
      `file count change` =
        `new file count` - `old file count`,
      `folder cost change` =
        `new folder cost` - `old folder cost`
    ) %>%
    full_join(join_dupes, by = "folder path") %>%
    mutate(
      across(
        c(`old dupe count`, `new dupe count`),
        ~ replace_na(., 0)
      ),
      `dupe count change` =
        `new dupe count` - `old dupe count`
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      status = case_when(
        `old folder size gb` == 0 &
          `new folder size gb` > 0 ~ "New",

        `old folder size gb` > 0 &
          `new folder size gb` == 0 ~ "Removed",

        abs(`folder size change gb`) < epsilon &
          `file count change` == 0 &
          abs(`folder cost change`) < epsilon &
          `dupe count change` == 0 ~ "Unchanged",

        TRUE ~ "Modified"
      )
    ) %>%
    select(
      `Accountable Excluded Manager Position`,
      `Accountable Excluded Manager Incumbent`,
       status,
      `folder path`,
      `previous quarter drive size gb` = `old folder size gb`,
      `new quarter drive size gb` = `new folder size gb`,
      `drive size change gb` = `folder size change gb`,
      `previous quarter drive cost/month` = `old folder cost`,
      `new quarter drive cost/month` = `new folder cost`,
      `drive cost change/month` = `folder cost change`,
      `previous quarter file count` = `old file count`,
      `new quarter file count` = `new file count`,
      `file count change`,
      `previous quarter dupe count` = `old dupe count`,
      `new quarter dupe count` = `new dupe count`,
      `dupe count change`
      )
}

joined_totals <- Map(
  join_totals,
  folder_totals_old,
  folder_totals_new,
  joined_dupes
)

#head(joined_totals$hq_kam_pwcc)
```

```{r write output to Excel file, include = FALSE}
# create workbook
excel <- createWorkbook()

# create sheet names
firstSheet = "Depot"
secondSheet = "HQ Victoria"
thirdSheet = "HQ Kamloops PWCC"

# add worksheets to workbook
sheet.names(firstSheet)
sheet.names(secondSheet)
sheet.names(thirdSheet)

# assign data tables to worksheets
dt.worksheets(1, joined_totals$depot)
dt.worksheets(2, joined_totals$hq_victoria) 
dt.worksheets(3, joined_totals$hq_kam_pwcc) 

# freeze top row of all sheets
freeze.panes(1)
freeze.panes(2)
freeze.panes(3)

# (Optional) Add filter
column.filter(1)
column.filter(2)
column.filter(3)

# set conditional colour format on columns 7, 10, 13, and 15 for values < 0
cond.colour(1, nrow(joined_totals$depot))
cond.colour(2, nrow(joined_totals$hq_victoria))
cond.colour(3, nrow(joined_totals$hq_kam_pwcc))

# set currency format on column
currency.format(1, nrow(joined_totals$depot))
currency.format(2, nrow(joined_totals$hq_victoria))
currency.format(3, nrow(joined_totals$hq_kam_pwcc))

# set custom column widths for all sheets
column.width(1)
column.width(2)
column.width(3)

# use params$output_dir when rendered, otherwise use local test folder
output_dir <- if (exists("params") &&
                  !is.null(params$output_dir)) {
  params$output_dir
} else {
  here::here("output")
}

if (!dir.exists(output_dir)) {
  dir.create(output_dir, recursive = TRUE)
}

if (length(joined_totals) == 0) {
  stop("joined_totals is empty")
}

subline <- if (exists("params") &&
               !is.null(params$subline)) {
  params$subline
} else {
  "TEST"
}

# output file name
safe_subline <- gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9_]", "_", subline)

output_excel <- paste0(
  "BCWS_Drive_Comparison_Report_",
  safe_subline,
  ".xlsx"
)

# full file path
output_file <- file.path(output_dir, output_excel)

# save the workbook to file
saveWorkbook(
  excel,
  file = output_file,
  overwrite = TRUE
)

message("Workbook saved to: ", output_file)
```
